lastCompletedStory.title: Explicit rehydrate delivery on respawn (CAM-141 fix) with cold-start safety

nextStoryContext: US-005 added explicit CAM_ORCH_REHYDRATE env-var delivery in buildOrchestratorPaneCommand (after mv handoff->consumed, before uuidgen) and replaced the unconditional .cam-orch-handoff.json boot prompt paragraph with an env-gated one. The boot prompt now says: run `echo $CAM_ORCH_REHYDRATE`; if non-empty read that path; else cold-boot (do NOT read stale handoff). The consume-once + cap invariants are preserved. US-006 is the next story: update subagent-orchestrator.md (and its templates mirror + embedded vendor) to describe the deterministic recycle flow (write handoff+cycle-close, wrapper owns SIGTERM+respawn+rehydrate) and remove the stale 'exit cleanly' self-exit prose.
